Section 1. Request for external review

A covered person may request an external review of a final denial. The request must be made in writing to the health plan within one hundred eighty days of the final denial. An expedited review may be requested orally when the treating physician certifies that waiting would seriously jeopardize the person's health.

Section 2. Timing of standard review

Within five days after receiving a complete request, the health plan shall send all documents it relied on to the independent review organization. The review is not delayed if the plan fails to send them, and the independent review organization may reverse the denial when the plan misses the deadline.
